the MT neurons are not frequency-separable but velocity-separable.

The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the context of a simple visual motion task, MT neurons can be well described either as velocity- or frequency-separable.
, in MT, the selectivity to motion is primarily determined by the spatial structure of the visual stimulus.
